Hi Maria,

Thanks — got the form. I've attached our activation checklist draft (activation-checklist-v1.docx) and sketched the minimum signer rotation we recommend for sealed/offline rollouts. Highlights:

1) Pre-ship:
   - RCA (release candidate) bundle signed with vendor GPG and Redwood primary signer (key id: RW-PRI-2026).
   - Manifest contains SHA256 checksums and signed metadata (bundle-manifest.json).

2) Courier & acceptance:
   - Two-person operator acceptance at vault door (customer + Redwood operator OR customer + independent auditor).
   - Secondary signer must be present for activation if primary signer is not on site; secondary must have pre-registered key and live-photo match on arrival.

3) Activation window:
   - Canary activation on a single host (non-prod VLAN) for warm smoke tests before full fleet promotion.
   - Rollback artifacts staged on sealed media in case of mismatch.

4) Evidence collection:
   - Signed acceptance form, timestamped photos, courier manifest, and operator initials.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick call Mon 10/12 10:00 PT to align signer roster and final courier SLA.
- Naomi to own signer roster and coordinate with SecureCourier.

Escalation contact during the window: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai, +1-415-555-0192).

I'll also drop a Drive link with a template and sample documents: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/airlock-activation-checklist-v1

--
Karthik Iyer
